name: io.github.Adeniyikayodee/ng-postcode
title: Nigeria Postcode
description: Validate, look up and resolve addresses to Nigeria's NIPOST digital postcodes (NDAPS).

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NIPOST Postcode API key from dashboard.postcode.gov.ng. Validation works without it.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_MAX_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Highest lookup level tools may request. Levels 2 and up consume NIPOST credits.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_MAX_PAID_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: How many paid lookups one run of the server may make with its own key.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Alternative API host, such as a staging stack.

environmentVariables.name: NG_GEOCODER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Nominatim server used by resolve_address to place described addresses. Ideally your own instance.

environmentVariables.name: NG_GEOCODER_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: URL or email identifying you to the geocoder. Required for the public Nominatim.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (default), or http to serve streamable HTTP at /mcp on NG_POSTCODE_HOST and NG_POSTCODE_PORT.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address the HTTP transport listens on.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the HTTP transport listens on.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_ALLOW_SHARED_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the HTTP transport start with a server key on a public address.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Host names the HTTP transport answers to, separated by commas. Required with a server key on a public address.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NIPOST Postcode API key from dashboard.postcode.gov.ng. Validation works without it.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_MAX_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Highest lookup level tools may request. Levels 2 and up consume NIPOST credits.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_MAX_PAID_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: How many paid lookups one run of the server may make with its own key.

environmentVariables.name: NG_POSTCODE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Alternative API host, such as a staging stack.
